master.txt: {n} carries the master’s relic: +1 HP, +5 aim

family.txt: The brother joins up (free recruit); {n} +1 HP

home.text: Raiders are torching {n}’s home village. Hold the line until the militia comes.

medical.desc: Fully heal the most wounded unit now (level 2: the two most wounded).

armory.desc: Next battle: troopers +1 armor pip and +1 grenade or medkit.

gardens.desc: Every unit −20 stress; the darkest Jedi sheds 1 Darkness.

sp0.tip: Research +4 days per mission, +1 Intel a month.

sp1.tip: Every unit sheds 8 stress per mission; squads get +5 will in battle.

sp2.tip: +3 Senate Favor a month: the Order mediates for the Republic.

sp3.tip: Every unit you deploy gains 5 more XP per mission.

kyber2.tip: With the Kyber Forge built: +2 Kyber a month.

holocron.tip: With the Archives built: research +6 days per mission. Found: +4 Intel.

crypt.tip: Order Darkness −1 a month. The old masters rest easy.

spring.tip: Wounded heal 2 more days and everyone sheds 3 stress per mission.

guard.tip: With the Barracks built: +1 Recruit a month.

cache.tip: With the Armory built: +10 Credits per won mission. Found: +40 Credits.

hall.tip: With the Training Salle built: units who sit out a mission gain 4 XP.

Consular.desc: +5 Senate Favor after each won Senate crisis.

refugees.text: A hundred thousand refugees crowd Coruscant’s lower levels. The Senate asks the Order to help.

defector.text: An Imperial officer offers fleet codes for safe passage and a payout.

guard.text: Masters argue the Temple is too exposed. Hire Temple Guard, or trust the Force.

frontline.text: The Senate wants Jedi leading Republic battalions.

opts.t: Refuse: we are not an army

acolyte.text: A young Sith acolyte sits in the Temple cells. What do we do with her?

caravan.text: A kyber shipment can be bought for the Order before the Senate claims it.

expedition.text: Archivists found coordinates to a lost Jedi outpost.

hutts.text: A Hutt clan offers “protection” for Republic convoys near the Temple’s supply lanes.

memorial.text: The war has taken many. Some ask for a memorial in the Temple gardens.

tithe.text: Senators question what the Order does with its stipend.

initiates.text: Force-sensitive teens beyond the usual age ask to train.

spies.text: Intel suggests an Imperial spy in a senator’s office.

relief.desc: +2 recovery per day; monthly stipend −30 Cr.

discretion.desc: Covert ambush −10%, capture −5%; monthly upkeep 25 Cr.

reclamation.desc: +20 Cr per victory; monthly Order Darkness +1.
